choice.basis: The pie chart 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' shows explicit market_share values: Apple = 60%, Samsung = 12%, Xiaomi = 10%, Others = 18%. Among the selectable brands (Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi), Apple has the highest current market_share (60% > 12% > 10%). 'Others' is an aggregate, not a selectable brand. The promotion rule assigns the premium retail promotion to the current market-share leader.
